notes.title: We have just released a major update of our game The Undisputables
notes.content:
Hello everyone

-We have just released a major update of our game The Undisputables, as you can see we have changed the graphic style of the environments to looks more beautiful using both precomputed static lightmaps and dynamic lights at same time to keep lighted environments even if you reduce the graphics quality from Ultra to Low.
-We have made changes on the post screen effects too to adapte to the new graphic style.
-We adaded Resolutions option to switch between different screen resolutions.
-Many more small updates on the UI, controls...
-Minor bug fix like the bug of the health no decreasing after getting shot some time.
-Updated our Demo version too with these new changes and added linux version of the Demo and making the Demo available again for every one to try the game for free.
and more...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40760119/170f2415cbdc63d29002ddb1f1b81adfea439447.png[/img]
